what: Three-lever composed fold at 512 aa: TT_BIO_UNFUSED_SILU + TT_BIO_DIT_COND_HOIST + (TT_BIO_FUSE_COND_MULADD and TT_BIO_FUSE_ATTN_GATE_ADD together as one lever).
why_a_new_digest: prediction.json is sha256-pinned to a TWO-lever stack. A three-lever claim does not get to reuse it.

protocol.estimator: paired per-rep against that rep's own mean of base at pos0 and posN, t-based 95% CI; min-based cross-check on sign only

inputs_measured_not_assumed.basis: inverse-variance pool of s3 (31 reps) and s5 (10 reps), both recovered with resummarise.py; silu +0.3342 se 0.0561, hoist +0.2880 se 0.0811
inputs_measured_not_assumed.eltwise_basis: c12-fused-eltwise-at-pin's op-level prediction, 178.3 Mc DRAM-real, of which 0.0953 s is built and op-verified. NEVER measured at the fold.

PREDICTED.ceiling_arithmetic: 0.5756 (pooled both, MEASURED) + 0.1321 (eltwise, PREDICTED) = 0.7077 s; x 1350 MHz = 955.4 Mcycles. This is a CEILING, not a prediction.
PREDICTED.why_more_subadditive_than_the_two_lever_: The two-lever stack measured 0.9148 of its own singles. eltwise's larger site is AdaLN's gated conditioning write-back, and cond-hoist works the same conditioning path -- the eltwise row flagged the overlap itself ('may be pricing the same bytes twice'). So the three-lever fraction should sit at or below the two-lever 0.9148, not above it.
PREDICTED.marginal_definition: all3 minus both, per rep. This is what eltwise is worth ON TOP of a stack that already ships, and it is the number that decides whether eltwise is worth landing at all.

KILL_CRITERIA: Any arm whose witness is 0 is VOID and its timing is not reasoned about. eltwise_calls must be >0 on eltwise and all3 and exactly 0 on base, silu and hoist.
A composed delta inside this session's own paired A/A 95% CI is not a result.
all3 below the LARGER single means the levers interact and the stack is not approvable as a stack.
If the all3 marginal (all3 - both) resolves BELOW zero, eltwise is a regression on top of the shipping stack and must be recommended against, whatever its op-level number said.
If the eltwise arm's marginal does not resolve at all, the honest report is that this session cannot price eltwise -- not that eltwise is worth its op-level 0.1321 s.
Margin: the composed delta must exceed 3x the paired A/A CI half-width. Read across sessions only if stated as such.
accuracy_plan: The three-lever stack's own deviation on cdk2x2_298 against that fixture's own seed floor, plus per-arm plDDT at 512 aa which is exact because each arm is bit-identical across its reps. Never by summing the individual levers.
not_in_this_stack: TT_BIO_LINEAR_KBLOCK stays off (concluded at ~0.035 s, below its own 0.10 s kill criterion, and _LINEAR_BLOCK is not keyed on operand placement).
